description: This file defines classes related to MPEG section parsing and management within the Thunder::Broadcast::MPEG namespace. It includes class definitions for 'Section' and 'Table', with methods for validation, data access, and section management, indicating it is part of a media processing or broadcasting system.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents an MPEG section with methods to validate, access fields like TableId, Extension, Version, and CRC validation.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Manages a collection of MPEG sections, allowing addition, validation, and storage of sections within a table structure.

methods.name: Section()
methods.description: Default constructor for Section class.

methods.name: Section(const Core::DataElement& data)
methods.description: Constructs a Section object from a data element.

methods.name: Section(const Section& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor for Section.

methods.name: ~Section()
methods.description: Destructor for Section.

methods.name: operator=(const Section& RHS)
methods.description: Assignment operator for Section.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the section is valid based on size and CRC.

methods.name: TableId()
methods.description: Returns the Table ID of the section.

methods.name: HasSectionSyntax()
methods.description: Indicates if the section has syntax.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the section.

methods.name: Extension()
methods.description: Returns the extension field if syntax is present.

methods.name: Version()
methods.description: Returns the version of the section.

methods.name: IsCurrent()
methods.description: Indicates if the section is current.

methods.name: IsNext()
methods.description: Indicates if the section is the next version.

methods.name: SectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the section number.

methods.name: LastSectionNumber()
methods.description: Returns the last section number.

methods.name: Hash()
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the section.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns the data element representing the section data.

methods.name: GetNumber<TYPE>(uint16_t offset)
methods.description: Template method to get a number of specified type from the section data at a given offset.

methods.name: ValidCRC()
methods.description: Validates the CRC of the section.

methods.name: Offset()
methods.description: Calculates the offset where section data begins.

methods.name: BaseLength()
methods.description: Calculates the base length of the section.

methods.name: DataLength()
methods.description: Calculates the length of the data payload.
